detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯超越安东内利夺冠，维斯塔潘严重撞车
兰多·诺里斯在F1荷兰大奖赛与基米·安东内利的较量中胜出，取得连续第二场胜利
F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯奉献了一场精彩绝伦的驾驶，从杆位出发赢得荷兰大奖赛，而主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘因撞车退赛引发红旗。
这位迈凯伦车手以11.5秒的优势领先亚军基米·安东内利冲过终点线，其梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔在赞德沃特登上领奖台最后一席。
此前，诺里斯在排位赛中力压冲刺赛冠军拉塞尔夺得杆位，安东内利位列第三，他们和其余车手一样，尽管发车前一小时有雨，仍使用干胎起步。
但雨水时断时续，造成湿干交替的路面，其危险在首圈结束时显现——诺里斯起步完美，而安东内利在第1弯超越拉塞尔。
这是因为维斯塔潘在最后一弯内侧将轮胎压到白线上，导致这位红牛车手打滑撞向护栏，碎片散落在赛道上。
“是的，就这样——抱歉！”这位荷兰车手通过车队无线电说道，他引发的红旗恰逢加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托也在倾斜弯道处发生360度打转，但不知何故避免了损伤。
随后又是一次静止起步——此前奥利弗·贝尔曼在编队圈遭遇引擎故障——这次令诺里斯沮丧，因为安东内利在第1弯挤过他以取得领先。
尽管迈凯伦使用软胎而安东内利使用中性胎，后者可谓双喜临门，因为争冠对手拉塞尔在第7弯将第三位输给了使用硬胎的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
拉塞尔就是没有速度，很快受到夏尔·勒克莱尔的压力，他报告了平衡问题，但狭窄的赛道让他得以坚守，直到第18圈将中性胎换成硬胎。
迈凯伦上一圈让皮亚斯特里进站回应，但事与愿违，一次缓慢的5.4秒停站让他落在拉塞尔之后，而安东内利此时已在前方领先诺里斯2.2秒。
进站窗口过后——所有领先车手除勒克莱尔使用中性胎外均选择硬胎——这一差距缩小到一秒，但卫冕冠军难以进一步逼近。
轮对轮的较量在更靠后的位置更为频繁：角田裕毅在一场争夺前十的多车混战中胜出，而勒克莱尔则一直紧咬皮亚斯特里。
这场小较量最终在第34圈结束，法拉利和迈凯伦在开局几个弯道并驾齐驱，勒克莱尔最终在第3弯外侧超越取得第四。
皮亚斯特里的苦难还未结束，下一圈他在第1弯被刘易斯·汉密尔顿超越跌至第五，后者迅速逼近队友勒克莱尔。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
这位七届世界冠军试图寻求车队指令，但指令并未到来，汉密尔顿讽刺地告诉法拉利车队：“浪费时间的绝佳方式，伙计们，干得好！”
汉密尔顿最终在勒克莱尔第43圈第二次进站后完成超越，勒克莱尔比梅赛德斯双雄晚两圈进站，比诺里斯进站换另一套硬胎早五圈。
但法拉利让汉密尔顿留在外面，使他占据赛道上的第一名，然而净领先位置的争夺在其身后展开，诺里斯迅速逼近安东内利，后者抱怨其后轮倍耐力轮胎。
于是到第54圈，汉密尔顿、安东内利和诺里斯都在一秒之内，卫冕世界冠军在第1弯外侧对安东内利完成了一次大范围超越。
就在同一圈，诺里斯随后在第11弯从汉密尔顿手中取得实际领先，汉密尔顿下一圈在第1弯落到安东内利之后——恰逢埃斯特班·奥康在第4弯停车引发虚拟安全车。
“你们把我当小白鼠吗，”汉密尔顿抱怨道，他想要进站，最终在虚拟安全车下进站换上软胎——安东内利同样如此，而诺里斯和此时升至第二的拉塞尔则留在外面使用硬胎。
诺里斯承认他对这一决定感到“担忧”，而且有理由如此，因为更新轮胎的优势显而易见，安东内利迅速缩小了与拉塞尔的差距。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯最终告诉这位英国人让队友通过，交换在第65圈第1弯完成，但这让拉塞尔暴露在汉密尔顿的威胁之下，他声称“我们丢掉了双领奖台”。
但拉塞尔坚守住了，得益于第70圈因第5弯碎片而短暂出现的虚拟安全车，他取得最后一个领奖台席位，落后安东内利4.3秒，落后诺里斯15.8秒，后者取得2026年第二场胜利。
汉密尔顿获得第四，勒克莱尔第五，皮亚斯特里第六，红牛替补利亚姆·劳森、奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格、阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索和阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利分别位列前十。
这一结果扩大了安东内利的冠军优势，这位19岁车手离开荷兰时以59分领先并列第二的拉塞尔和汉密尔顿。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Norris overhauls Antonelli for victory, Verstappen suffers heavy crash
Lando Norris came out on top in a battle at the F1 Dutch GP against Kimi Antonelli to take his second, consecutive win
Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris produced a mega drive to win the Dutch Grand Prix from pole while home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag by crashing out.
The McLaren driver crossed the line 11.5s ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli, with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell completing the podium at Zandvoort.
It came after Norris pipped sprint winner Russell for pole ahead of third-placed Antonelli and they all, like the rest of the grid, started on slicks despite rain an hour before lights out.
But the rain was on and off causing a wet-dry surface, the dangers of which emerged at the end of the opening lap once Norris had a perfect getaway while Antonelli overtook Russell at Turn 1.
That’s because Verstappen dipped a tyre onto the white line on the inside of the final corner, causing the Red Bull driver to spin into the barrier which spread debris on the circuit.
“Yeah that’s it - sorry!,” said the Dutchman via team radio, having brought out the red flag just as Gabriel Bortoleto also had a 360-degree spin at the banking but somehow avoided damage.
So another standing start followed - after Oliver Bearman suffered an engine failure on the formation tour - and much to Norris’ dismay this time, as Antonelli squeezed by at Turn 1 for the lead.
That was despite softs on the McLaren compared to mediums for Antonelli, who essentially had a double delight as title rival Russell lost third to hard runner Oscar Piastri at Turn 7.
Russell just didn’t have the pace, soon being pressurised by Charles Leclerc as he reported balance problems, but the tight track allowed him to hold firm before swapping mediums for hards on lap 18.
McLaren responded the previous lap with Piastri, but this backfired as a slow 5.4s stop put him behind Russell just as Antonelli had streaked 2.2s clear of Norris out front.
That gap closed to a second once the pit window - where all the frontrunners chose hard tyres bar Leclerc on mediums - had passed, yet the reigning champion struggled to make inroads.
The wheel-to-wheel battles were more prevalent lower down: Yuki Tsunoda came out on top in a mega multi-car fight for the top 10, while Leclerc was constantly on Piastri’s tail.
That little battle finally ended on lap 34 when the Ferrari and McLaren went through the opening corners wheel-to-wheel, only for Leclerc to edge by for fourth around the outside of Turn 3.
There was yet more misery for Piastri as he was overtaken for fifth at Turn 1 on the following tour by Lewis Hamilton, who quickly closed in on team-mate Leclerc.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
The seven-time world champion was angling for team orders but they did not arrive and Hamilton sarcastically told his Ferrari squad: “Great way of wasting time guys, good job!”
Hamilton eventually moved by though once Leclerc made his second pitstop on lap 43, two tours after the Mercedes duo, and five before Norris came in for another set of hard tyres.
But Ferrari kept Hamilton out which left him with first on track, yet the battle for the net lead emerged behind as Norris rapidly closed on Antonelli, who complained about his rear Pirellis.
So come lap 54 Hamilton, Antonelli and Norris were all within a second and the reigning world champion made a sweeping move on Antonelli around the outside of Turn 1.

It was that same lap that Norris subsequently took the actual lead at Turn 11 from Hamilton, who dropped behind Antonelli at Turn 1 the following lap - just as Esteban Ocon caused a virtual safety car by stopping at Turn 4.

“Are you using me as a guinea pig,” complained Hamilton, wanting to pit, and that he finally did under the VSC by taking softs - likewise for Antonelli, while Norris and now second-placed Russell stayed out on hard rubber.
Norris admitted he was “worried” by that decision and had reasons to be so, as the advantage of the fresher tyre became evident with Antonelli quickly reducing his gap to Russell.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
Mercedes eventually told the Briton to let his team-mate by with the swap occurring at Turn 1 on lap 65, but this left Russell vulnerable against Hamilton, claiming “we’ve lost a double podium”.
But Russell held firm, helped by a brief VSC on lap 70 for debris at Turn 5, to take the final podium spot, 4.3s behind Antonelli and 15.8s off Norris who took his second win of 2026.

Hamilton finished fourth, Leclerc took fifth and Piastri was sixth, while Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson, Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg, Aston Martin’s Fernando Alonso and Alpine’s Pierre Gasly respectively completed the top 10.
The result has extended Antonelli’s championship advantage, as the 19-year-old leaves the Netherlands with a 59-point lead over both Russell and Hamilton in second.

items.originalTitle: 诺里斯在赞德福特连续第二场获胜 | 2026荷兰大奖赛报告
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris claimed his second consecutive victory in a chaotic Dutch Grand Prix, while Max Verstappen retired after a heavy crash.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在一场充满变数的荷兰大奖赛中连续第二场夺冠。
比赛在第一圈结束时因马克斯·维斯塔潘在最后一弯严重撞车而出示红旗。这位红牛车手在湿滑赛道上打滑并重重撞上护栏，但并未受伤。
诺里斯在最初的起步中从杆位保持领先，而与他同排起步的乔治·拉塞尔则掉队。但在第二次静态起步时，从第二位发车的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利起步更好，超越了这位迈凯伦对手。
然而诺里斯在硬胎上速度出色，紧咬安东内利。他将第二次进站推迟到对手进站后六圈，并在第三段迅速追近。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿推迟了第二次进站并取得领先，到第53圈时，安东内利和诺里斯都在他后视镜中。当安东内利在Tarzan弯内侧试图超越他时，诺里斯抓住机会从梅赛德斯车手外侧绕过。在该圈稍后，汉密尔顿似乎能量耗尽，诺里斯在通往Hans Ernst Bocht的直道上轻松超越了他。
安东内利在下一圈超越了汉密尔顿。然而片刻之后，埃斯特班·奥康的哈斯赛车停下，触发了虚拟安全车，改变了最后几圈的格局。
汉密尔顿冲进维修区，但随着虚拟安全车时段延长，安东内利也在下一圈进站。因此比赛重启时诺里斯领先拉塞尔，两人都使用旧硬胎，安东内利和汉密尔顿则使用软胎在后面追赶。
诺里斯在硬胎上的速度非常出色，在还剩10圈时领先拉塞尔10秒。安东内利轻松追到拉塞尔身后，而拉塞尔在梅赛德斯下令后立即让队友通过。
几圈后，汉密尔顿在直道上准备攻击拉塞尔，但因另一次虚拟安全车时段而被迫放弃。这次原因是威廉姆斯车手在Tarzan弯相撞留下的碎片，小卡洛斯·塞恩斯锁死并滑撞亚历山大·阿尔本。
重启后汉密尔顿再次追近拉塞尔，但已没有足够圈数超越对手争夺第三。勒克莱尔也追近了两人，并在最后一圈接近Scheivlak弯时突然逼近汉密尔顿，几乎碰到队友的车尾。
诺里斯以11秒优势领先安东内利冲过终点线，拉塞尔获得最后一个领奖台位置。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在法拉利车手之后获得第六。
利亚姆·劳森在重返红牛后获得第七，尽管因黄旗违规被罚10秒。尼科·霍肯伯格在第一圈令人印象深刻地避开了打滑的队友，获得第八。
费尔南多·阿隆索驾驶升级后的赛车为阿斯顿·马丁取得本赛季最佳成绩第九名，皮埃尔·加斯利紧随其后。角田裕毅在回归后以第11名错失积分，领先队友阿维德·林德布拉德。
detailEn: Lando Norris claimed his second victory in a row in a lively Dutch Grand Prix.

The race was red-flagged at the end of the first lap after Max Verstappen crashed heavily at the final corner. The Red Bull driver was unhurt after spinning on the damp track and making heavy contact with the barrier.

Norris kept his lead from pole position at the original start while George Russell, who started alongside him, dropped back. But at the second standing start Andrea Kimi Antonelli made a much better getaway from second on the grid and passed his McLaren rival.
However Norris had good pace on the hard tyres and kept in touch with Antonelli. He delayed his second pit stop until six laps after his rival and quickly caught him in their third stint.

Lewis Hamilton delayed his second pit stop and took the lead of the race, and by lap 53 he had Antonelli and Norris in his mirrors. As Antonelli moved to pass him on the inside of Tarzan, Norris pounced and went around the outside of the Mercedes driver. Further around the lap, Hamilton appeared to have run out of energy, and Norris easily passed him on the run to the Hans Ernst Bocht.
Antonelli picked Hamilton off the next time by. However moments later Esteban Ocon’s Haas came to a stop, triggering a Virtual Safety Car period which changed the complexion of the final laps.

Hamilton dived into the pits, but as the VSC period dragged on Antonelli did likewise on the next lap. The race therefore restart with Norris leading Russell, both on old hard tyres, with Antonelli and Hamilton chasing after them on softs.

Norris’s pace on his hard rubber was excellent and he drew 10 seconds clear of Russell with 10 laps to go. Antonelli cruised up behind Russell, who immediately let his team mate through after Mercedes ordered him to.

A few laps later, Hamilton lined up Russell for an attack on the straight, but had to abandon his attack when another VSC period was triggered. This time the cause was debris left by a collision between the Williams drivers at Tarzan, Carlos Sainz Jnr having locked up and skidded into Alexander Albon.

Hamilton closed back up on Russell after the restart, but ran out of laps to pass his rival for third. Leclerc gained on the pair of them and closed suddenly on Hamilton as they approached Scheivlak on the final lap, almost clipping the rear of his team mate’s car.
Norris took the chequered flag 11 seconds ahead of Antonelli, while Russell claimed the final podium position. Oscar Piastri took sixth behind the Ferrari drivers.

Liam Lawson claimed seventh on his return to Red Bull despite receiving a 10-second time penalty for a yellow flag infringement. Nico Hulkenberg, who impressively avoided his spinning team mate on lap one, was rewarded with eighth place.

Fernando Alonso gave Aston Martin their best result of the season with ninth place in his updated car, followed by Pierre Gasly. Yuki Tsunoda missed out on a points finish on his return in 11th ahead of team mate Arvid Lindblad.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘在第一圈最后一弯严重撞车，引发红旗，车手未受伤。
诺里斯在第二次静态起步后被安东内利超越，但凭借硬胎速度在第三段追回并最终领先11秒夺冠。
汉密尔顿因虚拟安全车时机错失领奖台，最终位列第四，勒克莱尔第五。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen crashed heavily at the final corner on lap one, causing a red flag; he was unhurt.
Norris lost the lead to Antonelli at the second standing start but recovered with strong hard-tyre pace in the third stint to win by 11 seconds.
Hamilton missed out on a podium due to Virtual Safety Car timing, finishing fourth ahead of Leclerc.

“对，就是这样——抱歉！”这位荷兰车手通过车队电台说道，而就在他引发红旗的同时，加布里埃尔·博托莱托（博托莱托）也在倾斜弯道上转了360度，但不知怎的避免了损坏。
又一次起步发车接踵而至——此前奥利弗·比尔曼在暖胎圈中遭遇引擎故障——这让诺里斯大为懊恼，因为安东内利在1号弯挤到他前面抢走了领先位置。
尽管迈凯伦用的是软胎，而安东内利用的是中性胎，但安东内利可谓双喜临门，因为他的冠军竞争对手拉塞尔在第7号弯被硬胎策略的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里夺走了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔在比赛尾声阶段顶住了法拉利赛车的进攻。
拉塞尔就是没有速度，很快就受到夏尔·勒克莱尔的施压，同时他报告赛车平衡出现问题，但狭窄的赛道让他得以坚守阵地，直到第18圈才把中性胎换成硬胎。
迈凯伦在上一圈用皮亚斯特里做出了回应，但这适得其反，一次缓慢的5.4秒进站让他落到了拉塞尔身后，而此时在前方一骑绝尘的安东内利已经将领先诺里斯的差距拉开到2.2秒。
当进站窗口过去后——所有领先车手都选择了硬胎，只有勒克莱尔使用中性胎——这个差距缩小到了一秒，然而卫冕冠军却难以取得进一步突破。
轮对轮的较量在更靠后的位置更为常见：角田裕毅在一场激烈的争夺前十名的多车混战中笑到了最后，而勒克莱尔则始终紧咬皮亚斯特里的车尾。
这场小规模的缠斗最终在第34圈结束，当时法拉利和迈凯伦的赛车在开场的几个弯角轮对轮并驾齐驱，最终勒克莱尔在3号弯的外侧完成了超越，抢下第四名。
皮亚斯特里（Piastri）又遭遇了更多的不幸，在下一圈的第1号弯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）超越他夺得第五位，汉密尔顿随即迅速逼近队友勒克莱尔（Leclerc）。
这位七届世界冠军一直在试探车队指令，但指令迟迟未到，汉密尔顿于是语带讽刺地对他的法拉利车队说：“伙计们，真是浪费时间的好办法，干得漂亮！”。
不过，汉密尔顿最终还是完成了超越，因为勒克莱尔在第43圈完成了他的第二次进站——比梅赛德斯双车晚了 两圈，比诺里斯（Norris）进站换上另一套硬胎早了五圈。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿最终未能登上领奖台
但法拉利让汉密尔顿继续留在场上，这使他处于赛道第一的位置，而真正的领先争夺战在后方展开，诺里斯迅速逼近安东内利，后者抱怨他的后轮倍耐力轮胎出现了问题。
到了第54圈，汉密尔顿、安东内利和诺里斯之间的差距都在一秒以内，这位卫冕世界冠军在1号弯从外线对安东内利完成了一次大幅度的超越。
就在同一圈，诺里斯随后在11号弯从汉密尔顿手中夺得了实际领先位置，而汉密尔顿在下一圈的1号弯落后于安东内利——就在此时，埃斯特班·奥康在4号弯停车，触发了虚拟安全车。
“你是把我当小白鼠吗，”汉密尔顿抱怨道，想要进站，而他最终在虚拟安全车期间进站换上了软胎——安东内利也同样换上软胎，而诺里斯和此时排名第二的拉塞尔则继续使用硬胎留在场上。
诺里斯承认他对那个决定感到“担心”，而他也有理由如此，因为更新胎的优势很快显现出来，安东内利迅速缩小了与拉塞尔的差距。
梅赛德斯最终让这位英国车手让队友通过，在第65圈的1号弯完成位置互换，但这让拉塞尔在面对汉密顿时变得脆弱，他表示“我们失去了一个双领奖台”。
费尔南多·阿隆索驾驶升级版阿斯顿·马丁以第九名完赛。
但拉塞尔守住了位置，第70圈因5号弯出现碎片而触发的短暂虚拟安全车也帮了忙，最终拿下最后一个领奖台席位，落后安东内利4.3秒，落后拿下2026年第二场分站冠军的诺里斯15.8秒。
因此，Hamilton 获得第四名，Leclerc 取得第五名，Piastri 位列第六，而红牛替补车手 劳森、奥迪的 霍肯伯格、阿斯顿·马丁的 阿隆索 和阿尔派的 加斯利 分别完成了前十名的排位。
这一结果扩大了 Antonelli 在积分榜上的领先优势，这位19岁的车手离开荷兰时，对位列第二的 Russell 和 Hamilton 拥有59分的领先优势。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli from pole as Max Verstappen crashes out
Norris came out on top in a battle against Antonelli to take his second, consecutive win
Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris produced a mega drive to win the Dutch Grand Prix from pole while home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag and crashed out on the first lap.
The McLaren driver crossed the line 11.5s ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli, whose Mercedes team-mate George Russell completed the podium at Zandvoort.
It came after Norris pipped sprint winner Russell for pole ahead of third-placed Antonelli and they all, like the rest of the grid, started on slicks despite rain an hour before lights out.
But the rain was on and off, causing a wet-dry surface, the dangers of which emerged at the end of the opening lap once Norris had a perfect getaway while Antonelli overtook Russell at Turn 1.
That’s because Verstappen dipped a tyre onto the white line on the inside of the final corner, causing the Red Bull driver to spin into the barrier leaving vast debris on the circuit.
“Yeah that’s it - sorry!,” said the Dutchman via team radio, having brought out the red flag just as Gabriel Bortoleto also had a 360 at the banking but somehow avoided damage.
Another standing start followed - after Oliver Bearman suffered an engine failure on the formation tour - much to Norris’ dismay as Antonelli squeezed by at Turn 1 for the lead.
That was despite softs on the McLaren compared to mediums for Antonelli, who essentially had a double delight as title rival Russell lost third to hard runner Oscar Piastri at Turn 7.
George Russell held off the Ferrari's in the closing stages
Russell just didn’t have the pace, soon being pressurised by Charles Leclerc as he reported balance problems, but the tight track allowed him to hold firm before swapping mediums for hards on lap 18.
McLaren responded the previous lap with Piastri, but this backfired as a slow 5.4s stop put him behind Russell just as a dominant Antonelli streaked 2.2s clear of Norris out front.
That gap closed to a second once the pit window - where all the frontrunners chose hard tyres bar Leclerc on mediums - had passed, yet the reigning champion struggled to make inroads.
The wheel-to-wheel battles were more prevalent lower down: Yuki Tsunoda came out on top in a mega multi-car fight for the top 10, while Leclerc was constantly on Piastri’s tail.
That little battle finally ended on lap 34 when the Ferrari and McLaren went through the opening corners wheel-to-wheel, only for Leclerc to edge by for fourth around the outside of Turn 3.
There was yet more misery for Piastri as he was overtaken for fifth at Turn 1 on the following tour by Lewis Hamilton, who quickly closed in on team-mate Leclerc.
The seven-time world champion was angling for team orders but they did not arrive and Hamilton sarcastically told his Ferrari squad, “great way of wasting time guys, good job!”.
Hamilton eventually moved by, though, once Leclerc had made his second pitstop on lap 43, two tours after the Mercedes duo, and five before Norris came in for another set of hard tyres.
Lewis Hamilton couldn't quite make the podium
But Ferrari kept Hamilton out, which left him with first on track, yet the battle for the net lead emerged behind as Norris rapidly closed on Antonelli, who complained about his rear Pirellis.
Come lap 54 Hamilton, Antonelli and Norris were all within a second and the reigning world champion made a sweeping move on Antonelli around the outside of Turn 1.

It was that same lap that Norris subsequently took the actual lead at Turn 11 from Hamilton, who dropped behind Antonelli at Turn 1 the following lap - just as Esteban Ocon caused a virtual safety car by stopping at Turn 4.

“Are you using me as a guinea pig,” complained Hamilton, wanting to pit, and that he finally did under the VSC by taking softs - likewise for Antonelli, while Norris and now second-placed Russell stayed out on hard rubber.
Norris admitted he was “worried” by that decision and had reasons to be so, as the advantage of the fresher tyre became evident with Antonelli quickly reducing his gap to Russell.
Mercedes eventually told the Briton to let his team-mate by with the swap occurring at Turn 1 on lap 65, but this left Russell vulnerable against Hamilton claiming “we’ve lost a double podium”.
Fernando Alonso finished ninth in the updated Aston Martin
But Russell held firm, helped by a brief VSC on lap 70 for debris at Turn 5, to take the final podium spot, 4.3s behind Antonelli and 15.8s off Norris who took his second win of 2026.

So Hamilton finished fourth, Leclerc took fifth and Piastri was sixth, while Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson, Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg, Aston Martin’s Fernando Alonso and Alpine’s Pierre Gasly respectively completed the top 10.
The result has extended Antonelli’s championship advantage, as the 19-year-old leaves the Netherlands with a 59-point lead over both Russell and Hamilton in second.

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛的五个快速要点
兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）连续赢得第二场F1分站冠军，证实了迈凯伦速度的提升——而基米·安东内利（安东内利）以第二名成绩扩大了积分榜领先优势
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利（安东内利），梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔），梅赛德斯；兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯），迈凯伦
诺里斯和迈凯伦依然势头强劲、状态正佳
兰多·诺里斯(诺里斯)是最不需要别人提醒他锦标赛下半场会发生什么的人。就在2025年他遭遇最心碎一幕的赛场——当时一次退赛让诺里斯的冠军梦看似彻底破灭——如今这位卫冕冠军再次成为了追赶者，他利用升级后的迈凯伦赛车开始不断蚕食基米·安东内利(安东内利)的领先优势。
诺里斯在匈牙利拿下本赛季首胜后，又在荷兰站夺得杆位，尽管迈凯伦在冲刺中的长距离节奏相对较差，这让人们对正赛的期望有所降温。
在混乱的开局阶段，诺里斯在第2圈静态重启时把领先位置丢给了安东内利。但凭借软胎，这位英国车手始终保持在可攻击范围内，并且当领跑者们换上硬胎后，他看起来势不可挡。
在第72圈中的第54圈，诺里斯在1号弯从外侧包抄了正在防守的安东内利，随后在直道尾段超越了尚未进站的刘易斯·汉密尔顿(汉密尔顿)拿下领先，并轻松保持这一位置直到终点。
诺里斯连续第二场获胜后，他与安东内利之间的差距从90分缩小到83分，但这仍然是一个巨大的优势。不过，很少有人会否认这位26岁的车手正处于极佳状态，同时迈凯轮的滚动式赛车研发已使其MCL40成为一匹潜在的常胜战车。梅赛德斯什么时候才能拿出自己的升级包来应对呢？
劳森充分利用了他突然回归红牛的机会
我们无法确定，但如果利亚姆·劳森（劳森）曾希望在去年中国大奖赛——赛季仅两站之后——被告知将失去红牛席位后，生活有朝一日能再给他一次与马克斯·维斯塔潘作为队友同场竞技的机会，这也不足为奇。
大约一年半之后，他通过在 小红牛 的强势回归重塑了自己的声誉，当伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕受伤缺阵时，这个机会到来了，而劳森牢牢抓住了它。
他在周五稳扎稳打，但在周六的排位赛中大放异彩——考虑到红牛2026年赛车的实际情况——表现出色地拿下第八位，紧随Verstappen之后，仅相差0.115秒。诚然，赞德沃特是一条相对较短的赛道，但在今年被Verstappen在排位赛中击败的12次中，Hadjar此前只有三次能把差距缩小到这个范围之内。
Arvid Lindblad，小红牛车队；劳森，红牛 比赛车队。
Verstappen在起步后不久发生撞车，这让Lawson成为红牛阵营的领军人物。虽然他无法匹敌前六名的速度，但这位新西兰车手完成了一场扎实的比赛，以孤独的第七名完赛。
这不会为他赢得重返红牛的永久席位，他在小红牛的2027年前景也仍不确定。但Lawson充分利用了他意外的第二次机会——或许只是刚刚让自己重新进入了其他车队的视野。
角田裕毅在出人意料的F1回归中与前十名擦肩而过
在红牛车队再次面对维斯塔潘对劳森来说是项艰巨任务，但角田裕毅面临的挑战更为艰难。
作为替补车手代替劳森出战小红牛，这位替补车手从未驾驶过2026年规格的F1赛车，这种赛车在各个方面都与去年的截然不同——尤其是在全新的能量管理要求方面。
不出所料，角田在周末唯一一次自由练习赛中落后于表现出色的新秀队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德超过十分之八秒，但他在冲刺排位赛中逐渐将差距缩小到约十分之四秒，在正赛排位赛中则缩小到百分之一秒至十分之一秒之间。
这位日本车手随后从第12位发车完成了一场令人信服的比赛。他似乎没有犯任何错误，即使需要应对两次静止起步，并且在冲过方格旗时以令人惊叹的超越动作超过阿尔派车队的加斯利，最终获得第11名。
Lindblad因在黄旗状态下违规早早吃到了一次穿越维修区处罚，这使得两者之间的比较变得困难，但Tsunoda仍然表现出色，如果Hadjar的康复进程恰好比计划慢的话，看看他如何看待可能获得的第二次出场机会将会很有意思。
Verstappen撞车后，荷兰大奖赛再无童话般的结局
曾几何时，Verstappen在荷兰大奖赛上获胜就像英超球队对阵第四级别联赛球队必胜一样板上钉钉。这位红牛车手在2021年至2023年期间在他的主场大奖赛上连续三次夺冠，在那段Verstappen统治的时期里，没有什么能够阻挡他。
但随后迈凯伦（迈凯伦）到来，分别由诺里斯（Norris）和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）在2024年和2025年终结了这一连胜纪录，而2026年为维斯塔潘提供了最后一次再度品味主场胜利的机会，因为赞德沃特（Zandvoort）即将从F1赛历中退出。
红牛车队荷兰车手马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）撞毁的赛车
然而童话般的结局并未上演，因为维斯塔潘在第一圈就在“橙色军团”面前撞车了。这位四届世界冠军反正也从未真正具备竞争力，他在冲刺赛中仅排名第六，周日的正赛从第七位发车。
他认为这条赛道暴露了小红牛22的弱点，这座海边赛场让赛车出现了平衡问题。这不会是他所希望的，因为一方面这是他的主场比赛，另一方面这也是他签署新合同的周末。
Verstappen现在还有11次机会，阻止2026年成为他自2016年加入红牛以来第一个没有分站冠军的赛季。
Honda的新引擎不足以点燃阿斯顿·马丁的复兴
在夏休期前的匈牙利站进行重大赛车升级之后，这支位于银石的车队曾希望Honda的新动力单元能带来与底盘看起来同样大的进步。然而，很快情况就变得很清楚：Honda在2026年初以最差的引擎起步后，借助ADUO的帮助开发的升级版动力单元并不是一次重大改进，阿隆索和斯特罗尔都在冲刺赛排位赛和排位赛的第一节被淘汰。
车手们和Adrian Newey在周六很快把功劳归于底盘的改进，同时承认动力单元方面仍需取得更多进展。Stroll尤其直言不讳，直接表示车队缺乏大量动力，而Honda自己也承认，要给车手们带来他们所需的信心，还有很多工作要做。
替代策略加上极低的轮胎衰竭，使Alonso在比赛的大部分时间里都能处于积分区内，事实上，他也借此取得了今年第一个在赛道上获得的前十名成绩。正如这位西班牙车手所指出的，阿斯顿·马丁此前距离前方还很远，但即便有了这个强劲的成绩和一台看起来确实有所改进的底盘，引擎仍然是车队的薄弱环节，而且目前来看，这台引擎似乎还无法帮助这支绿色车队实现大幅反弹。
detailEn: Five quick takeaways from the F1 Dutch GP
Lando Norris won his second F1 race in a row, confirming McLaren's improved pace - while Kimi Antonelli stretched his championship lead by finishing second
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes, Lando Norris, McLaren
Norris and McLaren are still alive and well

Lando Norris is the last person who needs a reminder of what can happen in the second half of the championship. On the scene of his worst heartbreak in 2025, when Norris' championship looked dead and buried after a retirement, the defending champion is now the hunter once more after using an upgraded McLaren to start chipping away at the lead of Kimi Antonelli.
Norris backed up a first win of the campaign in Hungary with pole in the Netherlands, though McLaren's comparatively poor long run pace in the sprint dampened expectations in the grand prix proper.

In a chaotic opening phase, Norris lost his lead to Antonelli on lap 2's standing restart. But on soft tyres, the Briton stayed within striking distance and looked imperious once the frontrunners switched to the hard compound.

On lap 54 of 72 Norris swept around the outside of a defending Antonelli into Turn 1, before dispatching Lewis Hamilton - who had yet to stop - on the back straight to take the lead of the race, which he would comfortably retain until the finish.

Norris' second consecutive win brought his gap to Antonelli down from 90 to 83 points, which is still a huge margin. But few will argue the 26-year-old has hit a rich vein of form, while McLaren's rolling car development has turned its MCL40 into a potential serial winner. When will Mercedes be able to respond with its own upgrade package?
Lawson made the most of his sudden Red Bull return

We can’t know for certain, but it would hardly be surprising if Liam Lawson had hoped that, after being told he would lose his Red Bull seat following last year’s Chinese Grand Prix, just two races into the season, life might one day give him another chance to measure himself against Max Verstappen as his team-mate.

Almost a year and a half later, and having rebuilt his reputation with a strong return to Racing Bulls, that chance arrived when Isack Hadjar suffered a wrist injury, and Lawson grabbed it with both hands.

He took things steadily on Friday, but came alive on Saturday with an excellent qualifying performance — given the reality of Red Bull’s 2026 car — to take eighth, just behind Verstappen and only 0.115s away. Yes, Zandvoort is a relatively short lap, but Hadjar had only been within that margin of the Dutchman on three occasions this year, across the 12 times he was outqualified by Verstappen.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Red Bull Racing
Verstappen’s crash shortly after the start left Lawson leading Red Bull’s effort. While he couldn’t match the pace of the top six, the New Zealander delivered a solid race to finish a lonely seventh.

It won’t earn him a permanent return to Red Bull, and his Racing Bulls future for 2027 remains uncertain. But Lawson made the most of his unexpected second chance — and may just have put himself back on the radar of other teams.
Yuki Tsunoda narrowly misses top 10 on unexpected F1 return
Going up against Verstappen again at Red Bull was a tall order for Lawson, but Yuki Tsunoda faced an even tougher challenge.

Standing in for Lawson at Racing Bulls, the reserve driver had never driven 2026-spec Formula 1 machinery, which is dramatically different from last year’s in every area – particularly the novel energy management requirements.

Tsunoda unsurprisingly lagged behind impressive rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad by over eight tenths in the weekend’s sole free practice session but gradually reduced his deficit to about four tenths in sprint qualifying and one hundredth to one tenth in the main qualifying session.

The Japanese racer then performed a convincing drive from 12th on the grid. He seemingly didn’t put a foot wrong, even with two standing starts to handle, and performed a breathtaking move on Alpine’s Pierre Gasly on his way to 11th position under the chequered flag.

Lindblad getting a drive-through penalty early on for a yellow-flag infringement makes the comparison difficult, but Tsunoda still did well, and it would be interesting to see what he makes of a potential second outing if Hadjar’s recovery happens to be slower than planned.
No fairytale Dutch GP ending after Verstappen crash

There was once a time where victory at the Dutch Grand Prix for Verstappen seemed as guaranteed as a victory would be for a Premier League side against one from the fourth division. The Red Bull driver won three on the bounce at his home race from 2021 to 2023 and during that period of Verstappen dominance, there was nothing stopping him.

But then came McLaren, who respectively ended that streak in 2024 and 2025 via Norris and Oscar Piastri, yet 2026 offered one final opportunity for Verstappen to once again taste home success as Zandvoort is set to drop off the F1 calendar.
Crashed car of Red Bull Racing's Dutch driver Max Verstappen

Yet the fairytale ending wasn’t to be, as Verstappen crashed on the opening lap in front of the ‘Orange Army’. The four-time world champion was never really in contention anyway, as he finished sixth in the sprint race and started Sunday’s grand prix in seventh.

He reckons the circuit exposed the weaknesses of the RB22, which endured balance problems at the seaside venue. Not what he would have hoped for given, a, it was his home race and also, b, it being the weekend he has signed a new contract.
Verstappen now has 11 more chances to stop 2026 from being his first winless season since joining Red Bull in 2016.
Honda's new engine won't be enough to spark Aston Martin's revival

After Aston Martin's major car upgrade in Hungary just before the summer break, the Silverstone-based team had hoped Honda's new power unit would deliver as big a step forward as the chassis appeared to have made. However, it soon became clear that Honda's updated power unit, developed with the help of the ADUO after starting 2026 with the worst engine, was not a major improvement, with Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll both eliminated in the first stage of the sprint shootout and qualifying.

The drivers and Adrian Newey were quick to point to the chassis improvements on Saturday, while admitting that more progress was still needed on the power unit side. Stroll was particularly candid, saying outright that the team was lacking a lot of power, while Honda itself admitted there was still more work to do to give its drivers the confidence they needed.

The alternative strategy and very low tyre degradation allowed Alonso to run in the points for much of the race and, in fact, secure his first top-10 finish on the road this year. As the Spaniard pointed out, Aston Martin was previously much further away from the front, but even with this strong result and a chassis that appears to have genuinely improved, the engine remains the team's weak point and, for now, does not look capable of enabling a major comeback for the green outfit.

detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格表示，乔治·拉塞尔在经历了艰难的F1开局后已经"重回最佳状态"
尼科·罗斯伯格认为，在2026年F1赛季艰难的上半程之后，乔治·拉塞尔已经恢复到了他的最佳状态
2016年F1冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，乔治·拉塞尔终于回到了他的最佳状态。
拉塞尔在2026赛季的开局相当坎坷。这位英国车手以夺冠热门的身份来到揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛，但在墨尔本站和中国站冲刺赛获胜之后，他遭遇了诸多问题，包括打乱他策略的不合时宜的安全车以及赛车故障。
与此同时，他十几岁的队友安东内利在日本大奖赛登上车手积分榜榜首，并在赛季上半段总共赢得了六场大奖赛。
但这位28岁的车手在夏休期后焕然一新地回归。他从杆位出发赢得了荷兰冲刺赛，并在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中获得第二。
在接受天空体育 F1采访时，Rosberg表示，围场里的人对Russell在赛季早些阶段缺乏纯粹速度这件事感到措手不及。
"他在赛季上半段的表现让我们所有人都非常惊讶，"Rosberg解释道，"你提到了运气不好，但不仅仅是运气不好，他的速度也不够快。Antonelli就是更快的那位车手。
"所以这周末看到他恢复到最佳状态真是太棒了，他看起来状态非常在线。也许他的订婚让他大脑里的某个开关被打开了。现在事情尘埃落定，他终于放松下来了，又变回了从前那个拉塞尔。
"这就是我们所知道的、他有能力达到的水平。"
Russell向天空体育 F1解释说，他现在对赛车的感觉更加直觉化了。"我希望这种状态（我的好状态）能继续保持。这个周末感觉更像一个正常的周末。赛车的手感更直觉化了，我对赛车更有信心，一切也就来得更自然了。
"看看今天会带来什么吧。这将会是一场有趣的比赛。我认为法拉利会很快，Lando也会很快，所以这将是一场精彩的较量。"
detailEn: Nico Rosberg says George Russell is "back at his best" after difficult F1 start
Nico Rosberg believes George Russell has returned to his best form after a difficult first half of the 2026 Formula 1 season
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg believes George Russell is finally back to his best form.

Russell has endured a tricky start to the 2026 season. The Briton arrived at the season-opening Australian Grand Prix as a title favourite, but after winning in Melbourne and the Chinese sprint race, he faced multiple issues, including ill-timed safety cars that hampered his strategy and car problems.
Meanwhile, his teenage team-mate Kimi Antonelli took the lead of the standings at the Japanese Grand Prix and went on to win a total of six grands prix in the opening half of the season.
But the 28-year-old has returned after the summer break refreshed. He won the Dutch sprint race from pole position and qualified second for the Dutch Grand Prix.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1, Rosberg said the paddock had been caught off guard by Russell's lack of raw speed in some of the earlier stages of the season.

"It was a big surprise to all of us his performance in the first half of the season," Rosberg explained. "You mentioned bad luck but it wasn't just bad luck, he's also not been quick enough. Antonelli was just the quicker driver.

"So it's great to see him back at his best here this weekend, he seems really on it. Maybe his engagement has flipped a switch in his mind. He's finally relaxed now because that's done, and it's like the George Russell of old.
"This is the level we know he's capable of."

Russell explained to Sky Sports F1 that he was feeling more intuitive with the car. "I hope it [my form] continues. It feels more like a normal weekend. The car’s feeling more intuitive, I’ve got more confidence in the car, and then it just comes more naturally.
"Let’s see what today brings. It’s going to be an interesting race. I think the Ferraris are going to be quick, Lando will be fast, so it’s going to be a good fight."

items.summaryEn: The Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged on the opening lap after Max Verstappen spun into the barrier at the damp final corner. The race restarted at 3:33pm local time.
detailZh: 荷兰大奖赛在仅仅一圈后因马克斯·维斯塔潘的严重撞车而被出示红旗。
这位红牛车手在首圈结束时于倾斜的最后一弯打滑撞上护墙。
比赛在湿滑的赛道上开始，尽管维斯塔潘和其他所有车手都选择了干胎。最后一弯仍然特别湿滑。
当车阵抵达最后一弯时，维斯塔潘处于第七位。他似乎碰到了弯道内侧湿滑的路肩，这导致他的赛车打滑。当维斯塔潘试图纠正打滑时，他的赛车向左猛烈甩尾，并重重撞上外侧的护墙。
红牛赛车随后停下，维斯塔潘在爬出赛车前向车队致歉。
赛后发言时，维斯塔潘表示撞击没有可能发生的那么严重。“我想我仍然撞上了SAFER护栏，也许，有可能，”他说。“但我认为正面撞击实际上比侧面撞击要好一些，所以从这个意义上说，一切都还好。”
他并不是唯一在湿滑的最后一弯失去对赛车控制的的车手。两辆奥迪车手在加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托于尼科·霍肯伯格面前打滑后几乎相撞。虽然博尔托莱托令人印象深刻地在没有撞墙的情况下重新控制了赛车，但霍肯伯格在避让队友时上演了小小的奇迹。两人都继续比赛。
比赛于当地时间下午3:33重启。
detailEn: The Dutch Grand Prix has been red-flagged after a single lap due to a heavy crash for Max Verstappen.
The Red Bull driver spun into the barrier at the banked final corner at the end of the first lap.
The race began on a damp track, though Verstappen and all the other drivers opted for slick tyres. The final corner remained particularly wet.

Verstappen was in seventh place as the field reached the final corner. He appeared to touch the damp kerb on the inside of the corner, which tipped his car into a spin. As Verstappen attempted to correct the spin his car snapped hard to the left and made heavy contact with the barrier on the outside.
The Red Bull came to a rest shortly afterwards and Verstappen apologised to his team before climbing out.

Speaking after the race, Verstappen said the impact was not as serious as it could have been. “I think I still hit the SAFER barrier, maybe, potentially,” he said. “But I think also more frontal impact is actually a bit better than a sideways one, so from that sense, all okay.”

He wasn’t the only driver to lose control of his car in the damp final corner. The two Audi drivers almost collided after Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of Nico Hulkenberg. While Bortoleto impressively regained control of his car without hitting the barrier, Hulkenberg performed a minor miracle in swerving to avoid his team mate. Both continued.
The race restarted at 3:33pm local time.

事故发生时维斯塔潘处于第七位，他爬出赛车前向车队致歉，赛后表示撞击没有可能发生的那么严重。
同样在湿滑的最后一弯，奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托打滑，尼科·霍肯伯格紧急避让避免相撞，两人均得以继续比赛。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen appeared to touch the damp kerb on the inside of the final corner, which tipped his car into a spin before it snapped left and made heavy contact with the outside barrier.
Verstappen was in seventh place when the crash occurred; he apologised to his team before climbing out and said afterwards the impact was not as serious as it could have been.
At the same damp final corner, Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto spun and Nico Hulkenberg swerved to avoid his team mate; both continued.

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘撞车被红旗中断
马克斯·维斯塔潘最后一场F1主场比赛在首圈后结束，红牛赛车遭遇了巨大事故
F1荷兰大奖赛在首圈后因主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘的巨大事故而被红旗中断。
在潮湿赛道的首圈末段，维斯塔潘在赞德福特赛道最后一弯——通往主直道的倾斜全油门卢因迪克弯——内侧压到白线，导致红牛赛车失控。
维斯塔潘径直撞上外侧护墙，随后赛车横穿赛道，停在赛道内侧。
这位荷兰车手很快报告自己无恙，并为提前结束比赛向车队致歉。
维斯塔潘幸运地没有被其他赛车波及，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利采取了避让动作，与此同时奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格也险些遭遇巨大事故，因为他的队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托在他前方打转。
红旗期间所有车手聚集在维修区等待重启。他们必须在进入维修区前穿过一片碎片区，但车队被允许在红旗期间为重启更换轮胎。预计重启时间为当地时间15:33。
事发时维斯塔潘在令人失望的排位赛后排名第七。杆位得主兰多·诺里斯在混乱的起步阶段保持领先，积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利超越乔治·拉塞尔升至第二。
法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔上升两个位置，占据第四，领先于第二辆迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
对维斯塔潘而言，这起事故为他六年的主场作战画上了不幸的句号，他曾在2021、2022和2023年赢得荷兰大奖赛恢复举办后的前三届冠军。在组织者决定不再与F1管理层续约后，该赛事将从赛历中消失。
本周早些时候，这位四届世界冠军宣布他已将与红牛的合同延长至2030赛季末。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP red-flagged after Verstappen crash
Max Verstappen's final Formula 1 home race ended after one lap as the Red Bull suffered a colossal accident
Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix has been red-flagged after one lap following an enormous accident for home hero Max Verstappen.

At the end of lap 1 on a damp circuit, Verstappen lost control of his Red Bull as he tagged the white line on the inside of Zandvoort's final turn - the banked, flat out Luyendyk corner leading onto the main straight.
Verstappen veered head on into the outside wall, before his car crossed the track and came to a standstill on the inside.
The Dutchman soon reported he was OK and apologised to his team for ending his race early.

Verstappen was fortunate not to be collected by any other cars, with Alpine's Pierre Gasly taking avoiding action, while in the background Audi's Nico Hulkenberg also narrowly avoided a huge accident as his team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of him.

Under the red flag all drivers gathered in the pitlane awaiting the restart. They were having to navigate a field of debris before pit entry, but teams are allowed to change tyres under a red flag ahead of the restart. That restart is expected at 15:33 local time.

At the time Verstappen was running seventh after a disappointing qualifying session. Polesitter Lando Norris retained his lead during a chaotic start sequence, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli passing George Russell for second.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc gaining two positions to hold down fourth ahead of the second McLaren of Oscar Piastri and team-mate Lewis Hamilton.

For Verstappen, the accident marks an unfortunate end to a six-year spell racing on home soil, winning the first three editions of the Dutch Grand prix revival in 2021, 2022 and 2023. The race will disappear from the calendar after organisers decided not to pursue a contract renewal with F1 management.
Earlier in the week, the four-time world champion announced he had extended his Red Bull contract until the end of the 2030 season.

阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利采取了避让动作，奥迪车手尼科·霍肯伯格也险些卷入事故，其队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托在他前方打转。
红旗期间所有车手聚集在维修区等待重启，预计当地时间15:33重启；维斯塔潘事发时排名第七，这是他六年来最后一次在主场作战，此前他曾在2021、2022和2023年赢得荷兰大奖赛前三届冠军。

detailZh: 荷兰F1大奖赛因马克斯·维斯塔潘严重撞车而出示红旗
维斯塔潘的最后一场F1主场比赛在一圈后结束，这位红牛车手遭遇了巨大的事故
红牛车队荷兰车手马克斯·维斯塔潘撞毁的赛车
F1荷兰大奖赛在主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘遭遇严重事故一圈后出示红旗。
在湿滑的赛道上，第1圈结束时，维斯塔潘的红牛赛车失控，因为他压到了赞德沃特最后一个弯道内侧的白线——那是一个倾斜的、全油门通过的吕延迪克弯，通向主直道。
维斯塔潘的车头直接撞上了外侧护墙，随后他的赛车横穿赛道，停在了内侧。这位荷兰车手很快报告自己“没事”，并为提前结束比赛向车队道歉。
维斯塔潘很幸运没有撞上其他赛车，阿尔卑斯车队的皮埃尔·加斯利采取了避让动作，而在背景中，奥迪车队的尼科·霍肯伯格也险险躲过了一场严重事故，因为他的队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托在他前方打滑。
红旗期间，所有车手都聚集在维修通道等待重新起跑。他们必须在进入维修区之前穿过一片散落的碎片，但规则允许车队在红旗期间、重新起跑前更换轮胎。预计重新起跑时间为当地时间15:33。
当时，维斯塔潘在令人失望的排位赛后位居第七。杆位起步的兰多·诺里斯在混乱的发车阶段保持领先，积分榜领跑者安东内利超越拉塞尔升至第二。
法拉利车队的夏尔·勒克莱尔上升两位排在第四，领先于迈凯伦车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里以及队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
对维斯塔潘而言，这场事故为他在家乡赛道六年的征战画上了不幸的句号——他曾在2021年、2022年和2023年赢下荷兰大奖赛复兴后的前三届比赛。由于主办方决定不再与一级方程式管理公司续约，这场比赛将从赛历上消失。
本周早些时候，这位四届世界冠军宣布他已将红牛车队的合同延长至2030赛季结束。
detailEn: Dutch F1 grand prix red flagged after huge Max Verstappen crash
Verstappen's final Formula 1 home race ended after one lap as the Red Bull driver suffered a colossal accident
crashed car of Red Bull Racing's Dutch driver Max Verstappen
Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged after one lap following an enormous accident for home hero Max Verstappen.

At the end of lap 1 on a damp circuit, Verstappen lost control of his Red Bull as he tagged the white line on the inside of Zandvoort's final turn - the banked, flat out Luyendyk corner leading onto the main straight.

Verstappen veered head on into the outside wall, before his car crossed the track and came to a stand still on the inside. The Dutchman soon reported he was "OK" and apologised to his team for ending his race early.

Verstappen was fortunate not to be collected by any other cars, with Alpine's Pierre Gasly taking avoiding action, while in the background Audi's Nico Hulkenberg also narrowly avoided a huge accident as his team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto spun in front of him.

Under the red flag, all drivers gathered in the pitlane awaiting the restart. They had to navigate a field of debris before pit entry, but teams are allowed to change tyres under a red flag ahead of the restart. That restart is expected at 15:33 local time.

At the time, Verstappen was running seventh after a disappointing qualifying session. Polesitter Lando Norris retained his lead during a chaotic start sequence, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli passing George Russell for second.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc gaining two positions to hold down fourth ahead of the second McLaren of Oscar Piastri and team-mate Lewis Hamilton.

For Verstappen, the accident marks an unfortunate end to a six-year spell racing on home soil, winning the first three editions of the Dutch Grand prix revival in 2021, 2022 and 2023. The race will disappear from the calendar after organisers decided not to pursue a contract renewal with F1 management.
Earlier in the week, the four-time world champion announced he had extended his Red Bull contract until the end of the 2030 season.

items.summaryZh: 在赞德沃特举行的F1荷兰大奖赛于第二圈开始时被红旗中断，主场车手马克斯·维斯塔潘在最后一个弯失控撞上护墙。
items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛因维斯塔潘严重撞车被红旗中断
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort was red-flagged at the start of lap two after home hero Max Verstappen lost control and crashed heavily. He immediately reported to his team that he was unhurt.
detailZh: 在赞德沃特举行的一级方程式荷兰大奖赛中，第二圈开始时，本土英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘发生严重撞车，比赛随即被出示红旗。
这是暂时而言的最后一届荷兰大奖赛，因为赞德沃特将交出其赛历中的位置；维斯塔潘在驾驶小红牛22通过最后一个弯道时失去控制撞上护栏，由于大量碎片以及赛车所处的危险位置，比赛被迫立即暂停。
维斯塔潘立即向车队报告，他在事故中没有受伤。
赛前降雨使赛道潮湿，但已经干燥到足以让全部22位车手在起步时选择光头胎。
但赛车在通过最后两个弯道时激起了大量水雾，维斯塔潘（Verstappen）在第七位发生严重撞车——此前在那一圈早些时候，他与临时队友利亚姆·劳森（劳森）有过一些轮对轮的接触。
加布里埃尔·博托莱托（博托莱托）也在同一个弯道发生了严重打滑，但他避开了护栏，因此得以继续驾驶他的奥迪（奥迪）赛车。
当时兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯）正处于领跑位置，排在基米·安东内利（安东内利）之前。
detailEn: Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort was red-flagged at the start of the second lap following a big shunt for local hero Max Verstappen.

In what is the final Dutch GP for the time being, as Zandvoort relinquishes its place on the grid, Verstappen lost control of his RB22 navigating the final corner and went into the barriers, necessitating an immediate suspension of the race due to the amount of debris and the precarious position of the car.
Verstappen reported to his team immediately that he was not hurt in the incident.
Pre-race rain had left the track dampened but it had dried enough for all 22 drivers to favour slicks for the start.

But cars were kicking up a substantial amount of spray coming through the final two corners and Verstappen crashed hard out of seventh place - having had a bit of wheel-to-wheel contact with his stand-in team-mate Liam Lawson earlier in the lap.
There was also a huge spin coming through the same corner for Gabriel Bortoleto, but he avoided the barriers and thus was able to continue in his Audi.
Lando Norris was the race leader ahead of Kimi Antonelli at the time.

items.originalTitle: 罗斯伯格警告安东内利：F1冠军争夺战中的“心魔”
items.summaryEn: 2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg has warned that Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will face a growing psychological battle as he fights for his maiden title.
detailZh: 尼科·罗斯伯格警告基米·安东内利注意F1冠军争夺中的“心魔”
尼科·罗斯伯格警告称，领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利可能面临越来越大的心理挑战
2016年一级方程式冠军尼科·罗斯伯格认为，梅赛德斯车手、现任积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在争夺个人首个冠军的过程中将面临一场心理较量。
在荷兰大奖赛之前接受天空体育F1采访时，罗斯伯格结合自己夺冠的经历，解释了安东内利在赛季后期可能遭遇的心理压力。
Antonelli在他参加这项赛事的第二年表现出色，成为领跑积分榜最年轻的车手。但Rosberg警告说，随着争夺冠军的现实逐渐成为现实，压力将不可避免地增大。
"Antonelli的表现真是太出色了，"Rosberg解释道。"这是世界级的水平。太惊人了。这只是他在F1的第二年，难以置信。"
尽管给予了称赞，这位前梅赛德斯车手强调，对潜在夺冠机会的认知会带来干扰性的想法，这些想法可能会让车手的整个赛季偏离轨道。
"不过，他也只是个普通人，"他补充道。"任何处于他这种境地的人，随着赛季的推进，都会开始想'天哪，我的梦想触手可及'，脑海中的心魔会告诉你'你最好别搞砸了，这冠军是你不能输的'，这种想法不断重复且越来越响亮，你会开始在这种压力下挣扎，心想'天哪，希望我别搞砸了'。"
罗斯伯格在经过一场贯穿整个赛季的艰苦争夺、击败梅赛德斯队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿夺得2016年总冠军几天后，就从F1退役了。这位德国车手承认，冠军争夺战的压力使他在精神上已无法从赛车中榨取最佳性能。
“一旦你想到了那些事情，就会削弱你以100%状态驾驶的能力，”罗斯伯格继续说道，“我当时深陷其中，这就是为什么在我那个年代的最后四场比赛中，我根本没有机会拿到杆位或赢下比赛。我做不到。我的大脑已经烧坏了。”
安东内利目前以224分领跑车手积分榜。汉密尔顿以171分排名第二，乔治·拉塞尔以168分位居第三。
detailEn: Nico Rosberg warns Kimi Antonelli of F1 title "demons"
Nico Rosberg has warned that championship leader Kimi Antonelli could face a growing psychological battle
2016 Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg believes Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli will face a psychological battle as he fights for his maiden title.

Speaking to Sky Sports F1 ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix, Rosberg drew on his own championship-winning experience to explain the mental toll Antonelli could encounter during the latter stages of the season.

Antonelli has impressed during his second year in the series, becoming the youngest driver to lead the championship. But Rosberg warned that the pressure will inevitably mount as the reality of a title shot sets in.
"Antonelli has driven so incredibly well," Rosberg explained. "It’s a world-class level. It’s amazing. It’s his second year in F1, unbelievable."
Despite the praise, the former Mercedes driver stressed that the realisation of a potential championship victory introduces intrusive thoughts that can derail a driver's campaign.

"However, he’s only human," he added. "Anybody in his situation, as the season goes on, you start to reflect ‘my goodness, my dream is within reach’ and the demons in your head tell you ‘you better not mess this up, it’s yours to lose’ and that repeats and gets louder and louder and you start to struggle under that and think ‘oh my God I hope I don’t mess this up’."

Rosberg retired from F1 just a few days after beating Mercedes team-mate Lewis Hamilton to the 2016 title following a gruelling, season-long battle. The German admitted that the pressure of the title fight meant he was mentally incapable of extracting maximum performance from the car.

"Once you think about those things, it takes capacity away from your ability to drive at 100%," Rosberg continued. "I went through that big time and that’s why the last four races in my day, there was no chance for me to do a pole position or win a race. I could not. My brain was fried."
Antonelli currently leads the drivers' championship with 224 points. Hamilton sits second with 171 points, and George Russell is third with 168 points.

items.summaryEn: Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali has reacted buoyantly to Max Verstappen's contract extension with Red Bull, saying he cannot see F1 without him. The four-time world champion announced on Thursday a new deal taking his contract from the end of 2028 to the end of 2030.
detailZh: 斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利 "无法想象" 没有马克斯·维斯塔潘的F1
这位红牛车手周四宣布延长合同，意味着合同现在将到2030年到期
F1掌门人斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利对马克斯·维斯塔潘延长红牛合同做出了欣然的回应
这位四届世界冠军周四宣布，他与这支奥地利车队签署了一份新合同，将合同到期日期从2028年底延长至2030年底。
因此，这也终结了关于这位28岁车手可能在接下来的几个赛季离开F1的猜测——由于维斯塔潘对新规则的不满，这一传闻在2026年初甚嚣尘上。
但这项锦标赛已承诺在2027年进行调整，例如提高对内燃机（ICE）动力的依赖，这促使维斯塔潘将自己的效力延续至现行规则周期的结束。
多梅尼卡利在本周末的荷兰大奖赛上表示：“马克斯将在未来几年继续留在红牛的消息，是本周末蛋糕上的一颗樱桃。”
“这是一个很棒的消息。我感到非常自豪和高兴，因为马克斯是世界冠军，是一位世界级的杰出人物，在这项运动中拥有极佳的个人魅力，我无法想象没有他的F1。”
但这位荷兰车手未能在本周末以漂亮的方式庆祝他的新合同，因为红牛在赞德沃特陷入了困境——维斯塔潘曾于2021年至2023年在这里连续三年夺冠。
这位感觉“有点像感冒”的世界冠军在冲刺赛中仅获得第六名——也就是他的发车位，并在周日大奖赛的排位赛中名列第七，比杆位得主兰多·诺里斯慢了0.5秒。
他认为这条海滨赛道比大多数赛道更容易暴露小红牛22的弱点，而且这甚至与调校无关，因为他将与队友利亚姆·劳森共享第四排发车位。
“冲刺赛之后我们对赛车做了相当多的改动，但没有任何一项产生效果，”维斯塔潘说道。
“赛车的平衡是最大的问题。它在整个弯道中就是不够一致，而且整个赛季都是这样。只是在某些赛道上情况比其他赛道更糟一些。
“我们现在主要受到赛车一些根本性问题的限制，这些问题我们需要解决。
“在这条赛道上也有一些快速弯道，我们在这方面同样有所欠缺。总的来说，如果没有良好的平衡，你就无法真正全力攻弯；如果没有足够的抓地力，你也无法正常出弯，所以这一切都在损失时间。”
detailEn: Stefano Domenicali "cannot see" F1 without Max Verstappen
The Red Bull driver announced his contract extension on Thursday, meaning it will now expire in 2030
Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali has responded buoyantly to Max Verstappen extending his Red Bull contract.
The four-time world champion announced on Thursday that he’d signed a new deal with the Austrian outfit, taking the expiry date from the end of 2028 to the end of 2030.
It has therefore ended speculation that the 28-year-old may depart F1 in the coming seasons, which is talk that ran strife early in 2026 due to Verstappen’s discontent with the new regulations.
But the championship has committed to tweaks for 2027 such as increasing the reliance on ICE power, which led Verstappen to extend his stay through to the end of the current regulation cycle.
Domenicali said at this weekend’s Dutch Grand Prix: “The news of Max staying in Red Bull for the next couple of years is a cherry on the cake for this weekend.
“It’s great news. I’m very proud and happy because Max is a world champion, a world-class person that has a great personality in the sport and I cannot see Formula 1 without him.”
But the Dutchman has been unable to celebrate his new contract in style this weekend, as Red Bull has struggled at Zandvoort - where Verstappen won three on the bounce from 2021 to 2023.

The world champion, who is feeling a “bit flu-like”, only finished sixth - the position he started - in the sprint race and qualified seventh for Sunday’s grand prix, five tenths off polesitter Lando Norris.
He reckons the seaside circuit is a venue that exposes the RB22’s weaknesses more than most and it isn’t even related to set-up, as he will share the fourth row with team-mate Liam Lawson.
“We changed quite a lot on the car after the sprint, but none of it made any difference,” said Verstappen.
“The balance of the car is the biggest problem. It’s just not consistent throughout the entire corner, but it has been like that all season. It’s just a little worse at some circuits than at others.
“We’re now simply more limited by some fundamental problems with the car that we need to solve.

“At this circuit you also have some fast corners and we’re lacking there as well. In general, if you don’t have a good balance, you can’t really attack the corners and if you don’t have traction either, you can’t get out of the corners properly, so all of that costs time.”
